scenario: [LREG.8.1] — the inline flag group `(?i)` is RE2 syntax and must fold case. POSIX ERE has no inline flags and rejects the pattern. Under RE2 `"ABC"` matches. Expected count 2 = the Log fact plus the emitted Hit.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /(?i)abc/
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
